headline: BTG Projects 3tentos Corn Ethanol Business to Yield R$ 419 Million in 2027
summary: BTG Pactual projects that Brazilian agribusiness 3tentos will generate R$ 419 million in gross profit in 2027 from corn ethanol and coproducts, boosted by cheap corn supplies in Mato Grosso.
why: Corn ethanol is expanding rapidly across Brazil's agricultural heartland, competing with traditional sugarcane ethanol for domestic and international biofuel demand.

impacts.name: 3tentos Agroindustrial SA
impacts.why: Low corn feed costs enhance profitability prospects for 3tentos' biofuel operations.
